sources.snippet: Note on the Unified architecture.gemma-4-12B-it is the encoder-free Gemma4Unified model (released 2026-06-03). Its refusal signal concentrates in the upper decoder layers (L15-47), so only the top 70% of layers are abliterated — ablating the near-zero-SNR early layers adds distortion with no refusal benefit.
